Cokka
preceptor (?) of Rāma (a. of Kavidarpaṇanighaṇṭu,

Cokkaṇṇakavi
patronized by King Śarabhoji.
--Kumārasambhavacampū. composed for his patron. Burnell p. 157b (

ascribes it to King Śarabhoji).
See NCC. IV. p. 221a.

Cokkanātha(kandūri)
father of Nāganātha (a. of Rāmavijaya, Adyar D.

Cokkanātha
on different Cokkanāthas see T. S. Kuppuswami Sastri, Ind. Ant. XXXIII. p.. 126 ff. 176 ff; A. S. Ramanatha Ayyar, Ind. Ant. LII. p.. 1 ff.; S. Vaidyanatha Sastri, JOR. Madras, IV. p.. 261 ff.; K. Kunjunni Raja, Adyar Library Bulletin, X. ii. p.. 109-122.

Cokkanātha
Bhāradvāja gotra an. Chandoga pravara, belonging to Śāttanūr village on the banks of Kāverī; son of Sudarśana Bhaṭṭa an. Ācyambā; younger brother of Rāmacandra Bhaṭṭa; an. disciple of Hastigiri Bhaṭṭa.
On his identity, with father of Sadāśivamakhin (a. of Rāmavarmayaśobhūṣaṇa) see Ind.

(1924) p.. 1 ff. Later than Rājacūḍāmaṇi Dīkṣita whom he quotes. See K. Kunjunni Raja, Adyar Library Bulletin X. ii. Mss. Notes. p.. 109-122. [Page085-a.
--C. Bālavyutpattikāriṇī on Yudhiṣṭhiravijaya of Vāsudeva. Adyar D.

Cokkanātha
5th son of Tippādhvarin an. Narasāmbā; Bhāradvāja gotra an. Āśval. sūtra; brother of Kuppādhvarin, Tirumalādhvarin, Svāmiyajvan, Sītārāma Śāstrin; patronized by Sāhaji of Tanjore (1684-1711 A. D.) an. Keladi Basava (Ikkeri Basava Nāyaka, 1691-1714 A. D.). Q. poet Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita. [Page085-b]
--Kāntimatīpariṇaya. nāṭaka.

-41. See NCC. III. p. 341b.
--Rasavilāsa bhāṇa. mentioned by him in the prologue to the preceding work.
--Sevantikāpariṇaya. on the marriage of Sevantikā the daughter of a king of Malabar with Basava.

.

Cokkanātha_Dīkṣita_(Makhin)
mid. of 17th Cent. son of Nārāyaṇa alias Dvādaśāhayājin of Kauśika gotra an. preceptor an. father-in-law of Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita (a. of Jānakīpariṇayanāṭaka,
); preceptor of Sadāśiva Dīkṣita (a. of Gītasundara) an. father of Nalla Perumāl Dīkṣita (a. of C. on Śabdakaumudi). See Śāhendravilāsā, Tanjore Sar. Mah.

Cokkanātha_Dīkṣita
mid. of 18th Cent. Bhāradvājagotra; wife Mīnākṣī; father of Sadāśiva Dīkṣita (a. of Bālarāmavarmayaśobhuṣaṇa,

-73).
On his identity with the a. of C. on Yudhiṣṭhiravijaya, see Ind.
(1924) p.. 1 ff. See also K. Kunjunni Raja, Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 174 an. Adyar Library Bulletin X. ii. Mss. Notes. p. 115.
